Enum EDPEditorStatus

  • Object
    • Enum<EDPEditorStatus>
      • EDPEditorStatus
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<EDPEditorStatus>

    public enum EDPEditorStatus
extends Enum<EDPEditorStatus>
    This enumeration contains the valid arguuments for EDP command "GTS" to show status info of an editor.
    Since:
    abas Version 2007r4, EDP Version 3.21
    Version:
    1
    Author:
    male
    See Also:
    EDPEditor.getEditorStatus(EDPEditorStatus)

      • TATYPE

        public static final EDPEditorStatus TATYPE
        Transaction type (is constantly "EDIT").

      • MODIFIED

        public static final EDPEditorStatus MODIFIED
        Has the object been modified? Possible values are 0 = no, 1, = yes.

      • HASTABLE

        public static final EDPEditorStatus HASTABLE
        Does the object have a table part (which may be empty)? Possible values are 0 = no, 1, = yes.

      • NUMROWS

        public static final EDPEditorStatus NUMROWS
        Number of rows in current object.

      • ROW

        public static final EDPEditorStatus ROW

      • EDITROW

        Current editRow number in current objekt.

      • FIELD

        public static final EDPEditorStatus FIELD
        Current or last touched field in current object.

      • NEXTROW

        public static final EDPEditorStatus NEXTROW
        Row number from cursor positioning in last editor operation, if set.

      • NEXTFIELD

        public static final EDPEditorStatus NEXTFIELD
        Fieldname(s) from cursor positioning in last editor operation, if set.

      • STATE

        public static final EDPEditorStatus STATE
        State of current Transaction. Possible values: ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, INACTIVE

      • REF

        public static final EDPEditorStatus REF
        Reference of current or last edited object. This state is empty during creation of a new object and being updated during save.

      • ORIGREF

        public static final EDPEditorStatus ORIGREF
        Reference of original edited object.

      • NUM

        public static final EDPEditorStatus NUM
        Ident number of current or last edited object.

      • VERSION

        public static final EDPEditorStatus VERSION
        Version number of current record or the last edited one. If the last edited one has been saved, this status shows its new version number.

      • FILINGVERSION

        public static final EDPEditorStatus FILINGVERSION
        Filing version number of current record or the last edited one. If the last edited one has just been filed, this status shows its new filing version number.

      • ORIGROW

        public static final EDPEditorStatus ORIGROW
        Original row number of current row in current object. An original row number is the number of a row which has been read from database or which has been inserted by the client explicitly. A row which has been inserted from core or by FOP is a "wild" row and has a negative original number.

      • MAXORIGROW

        public static final EDPEditorStatus MAXORIGROW
        The largest yet given original row number in the open editor.

      • MAXWILDROW

        public static final EDPEditorStatus MAXWILDROW
        The largest yet given wild row number in the open editor.

      • ACTION

        public static final EDPEditorStatus ACTION
        Action of the editor.

      • EDITGRPNR
